caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure with brown skin and long, dark hair. He wears a red draped garment over his shoulders and back, and a dark brown, short skirt-like piece around his waist with matching leggings and moccasins. He is adorned with a large white necklace featuring a central red symbol. Atop his head, he has a headband with two feathers, one red and one yellow-green. The figure holds a long, slender spear or staff in his right hand, which extends upwards, and a bow in his left hand, which rests by his side. The figure stands barefoot on a gray rectangular pedestal. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery. The colors in the drawing are mainly earth tones, including shades of brown, red, and gray, with small accents of white and yellow-green.
title: Cigar Store Indian
